title: Oceanic Crisp Middle Eastern Fish Kibbeh
description: A tangy and crisp Middle Eastern dish featuring fish, perfect for a crowd, and made with a ssam-wrap style kibbeh, this recipe is a satvik-friendly delight.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the bulgur and water, letting it soak for 10 minutes.
Add the chopped onion, parsley, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and sumac to the bowl and mix well.
Add the cut cod fillets to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small football shapes.
Place the kibbeh on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with a little olive oil and bake for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Serve the kibbeh hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
Garnish with additional parsley and sumac if desired.
